Definition: from G3307 (through the idea of distraction); solicitude:--care.
BiblicalUsage: Merimna is care, the anxious solicitude that divides the mind. 1 Peter 5:7 commands us to cast all our care upon Him, for He careth for you, and 2 Corinthians 11:28 shows Paul carrying the care of all the churches daily. Luke 8:14 and Mark 4:19 both warn that the cares of this world, with riches and pleasures, choke the word and make it unfruitful.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe care is a burden with two owners: mine to carry until I cast it, and His to carry once I do. My position is that anxiety is not a small fault but a choking weed, and the cure is not trying harder but handing it over.
